desc.ian_image_library:title: Estuary 3D: River Mouth Triptych
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Triptych comparison of a river mouth, showing a pristine environment (left) with subsequent sediment, nutrients, and toxin inputs leading to an unhealthy and unproductive environment with a hardened shoreline (right).
